name: Promo flow
description: Plan, storyboard and review a produced video with the person in the loop.

slash.name: promo-flow
slash.description: Plan and review a produced video step by step

activate.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} started the promo flow. Their request, verbatim: {args}. Run: promo flow init, then publish the state.

approve.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} approved {gate}. Run: promo flow approve {gate} --by "{by}", then advance and publish the next state.

pick.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} picked scripts {picks}. Run: promo flow approve scripts-picked --picks {picks} --by "{by}".

share.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants {item} uploaded to {dest_label}. Run: promo flow share {kind} {n} --to {dest} --by "{by}", then publish the new state.

generate.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants the real thing made, not placeholders: {what}. Run: promo flow make (frames, then asset samples), then publish the new state.

widget.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} sent you a message from the panel "{title}" ({widget}): {text}. It is a request to change that panel or the video; do it (promo flow widget add --force | layout, or the usual flow commands), then publish the new state. Do not approve anything.
widget.sent: Sent your message from the panel

request.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} asked you to add to the plan (looking at the {where} tab): {text}. Do it with promo flow doc | plan pack | script | story | scene | density (see your skill, any length is fine), then publish the new state. Do not approve anything.

density.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants storyboard frames {what} for story {story}. Run: promo flow density --story {story} --every {every} (every 0 means --clear), then promo flow frames to draw them, then publish.

resume.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants the stopped run carried on ({what}). Run: {command}, then publish the new state.

settings.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} chose where new videos are saved: {output}. Run: promo config output "{output}" (home, repo and default are names; anything else is a folder), then publish the new state. If it fails, tell them why in one sentence.

scene_note.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} commented on scene {scene} of story {story} ({beat}): {text}. Run: promo flow scene note {story} {scene} --text "<their words>" --by "{by}", change the scene to answer it (promo flow scene set, --redraw and promo flow frames when a picture must change), then promo flow scene resolve {story} {scene} --note N --text "<what you changed, one line>" and publish. The storyboard approval goes stale if the board changed: say so. Do not approve anything.

pins.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} changed {count} note(s) on the timeline of draft {draft}: {list} Run one command per change, with their words verbatim: a new note is promo flow pin add --draft {draft} --at S --text "..." [--spot X,Y,W,H] --by "{by}"; a change is promo flow pin edit ID [--at S] [--text "..."] [--spot X,Y,W,H|none] --by "{by}"; a spot is the area they marked on the frame, and its marked frame lands in flow/pins/; a removal is promo flow pin remove ID --by "{by}". Then publish. Each note is a check on its scene for the next round.

restore.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants to go back to {what}. Run: promo flow restore --draft {draft} --scene {scene} --by "{by}" (leave out --scene when it is empty), rebuild the changed shots, register the new draft and publish.

ab.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} answered the blind pick {pair} ({question}): {label}. Run: promo flow ab pick {pair} --side {side} --by "{by}", then publish.

autopilot.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} asked you to {op} working on your own ({what}). Run: promo flow autopilot {op} --minutes {minutes} --by "{by}" (--minutes only for start). While it runs, work in passes (promo flow autopilot pass begin, then pass end) until it reports done, blocked or out of time, and publish after every pass.

overturn.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants something else than your choice "{choice}" ({id}): {text}. Run: promo flow assume overturn {id} --text "<their words>" --by "{by}", then publish. It becomes a check for the next draft.

drop.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} dropped check {id} ("{what}"): {why}. Run: promo flow check retire {id} --why "{why}" --by "{by}", then publish. Drafts are no longer held to it; do not re-add it.

forget.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} asked you to forget a remembered note: {text}. Run: promo flow lessons --forget {id} --by "{by}", then publish.

podcast.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} changed the podcast show in the Cast card ({what}): {list}. Run these in the project, in order (here ` ; ` separates them): {ops}. Then publish the new state. Do not approve anything.

edit.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} edited the video in the Stage's editor ({count} changes after {draft}: {list}). Run: promo flow edit render --by "{by}" --file - with these edits on stdin, one per line (here ` ; ` separates them): {ops}. It builds only what changed, checks it and registers the next draft; then publish. Do not approve anything.

edit_preview.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants a quick preview of {where} with their {count} edits from the Stage's editor. Run: promo flow edit apply --by "{by}" --file - with these edits on stdin, one per line (here ` ; ` separates them): {ops}. Then promo flow edit preview {range} (only those shots and the sound are built; the clip shows in the editor), then publish. Do not register a draft or approve anything.

edit_bin.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} opened the earlier project {name} in the editor's bin. Run: promo flow edit bin --open "{name}", then publish.

studio.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants a video take from the Studio ({what}). Their prompt, verbatim: {prompt} Run: commissionctl secret exec OPENROUTER_API_KEY --reason "Video takes from the Studio" -- promo flow studio run --prompt "<their prompt>" --model {model} --res {res} --seconds {seconds} --aspect {aspect} {flags} (it is priced and capped before it is sent, and publishes as it goes). For a cli: or local: model (cli:grok, local:depth), run the same promo flow studio run without secret exec: it needs no key. If secret exec says the key is missing, the secure key box is already open for them: tell them in one line to paste it there and end the turn; their save arrives as your next message, then rerun the same command. Never raise --max-usd or PROMO_GEN_DAILY_USD unless they ask. Do not approve anything.

studio_rerun.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants the final of Studio take {take} ({what}): the take's stored request sent again at {res}. They saw the price and confirmed it. Run: commissionctl secret exec OPENROUTER_API_KEY --reason "Video takes from the Studio" -- promo flow studio rerun --take {take} --res {res} (it is priced and capped before it is sent, and publishes as it goes; a take made on their own subscription runs without secret exec). If secret exec says the key is missing, the secure key box is already open for them: tell them in one line and end the turn. Never raise --max-usd or PROMO_GEN_DAILY_USD unless they ask. Do not approve anything.

studio_restyle.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants Studio take {take} restyled ({what}). What should change, verbatim: {prompt} Run: commissionctl secret exec OPENROUTER_API_KEY --reason "Video takes from the Studio" -- promo flow studio restyle --take {take} --prompt "<their words>" (FLUX Video Edit; priced and capped first; publishes as it goes). If the key is missing, the secure key box is already open: say so in one line and end the turn. Never raise --max-usd or PROMO_GEN_DAILY_USD unless they ask. Do not approve anything.

studio_swap.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants the person in Studio take {take} swapped ({what}). Who goes in, verbatim: {prompt} Run: commissionctl secret exec OPENROUTER_API_KEY --reason "Video takes from the Studio" -- promo flow studio swap --take {take} --prompt "<their words>" --prep {prep} (local face mesh / depth on this Mac, then Seedance 2.5 on OpenRouter; priced and capped first; publishes as it goes; a refusal stays on the take with its reason). If the key is missing, the secure key box is already open: say so in one line and end the turn. Never raise --max-usd or PROMO_GEN_DAILY_USD unless they ask. Do not approve anything.

studio_describe.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} asked you to describe storyboard frame {label} ({frame}) as a Studio prompt. Run: promo flow studio frame --frame {frame} (prints the picture), look at it, and write one prompt of its setting only, 1-3 sentences: place, light and time of day, lens and camera height, colour, mood. No people, and never name screens, apps, text or logos (the plate guard keeps them out; the command refuses those words). Then: promo flow studio suggest --frame {frame} --prompt "<your prompt>" (it publishes; they choose whether to use it). Nothing is billed. Do not approve anything.

studio_use.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants Studio take {take} as the sample of {label}. Run: promo flow studio use --take {take} --asset {asset}, then publish. It stays a sample until the plate is registered with promo gen register.

plate_gen.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants another take of music-video shot {shot}. Their pending plate edits for it (may be empty): {ops}. Run: promo flow edit apply --by "{by}" --file - with those edits on stdin (skip when empty), then promo mv gen -p promo.yaml --shots {shot}, then publish. The take lands in the shot's takes; the person picks it. Do not put it in yourself or approve anything.

bible.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} wants the look of the whole music video changed: {text}. Change the look bible with promo mv bible -p promo.yaml --prompt "<the new look in full, keeping what they did not mention>" (and --ref ROLE=FILE for new reference images), then tell them that every plate drawn before is now stale (gate look-bible) and ask before redrawing them all (promo mv gen). Publish. Do not approve anything.

edit_keep.message: [mod:promo-flow] {by} kept your editor suggestion {id} ({note}); its edits are now in their pending edits and render with their next Render. Run: promo flow edit keep {id} --by "{by}", then publish.
